lines.text: As his death drew near, David charged Solomon to be strong and walk in the LORD's ways.
David said Joab had killed Abner and Amasa in peacetime, and told Solomon not to let Joab die in peace.
David told Solomon to show loving devotion to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, who stood by him when he fled from Saul.
David said Shimei of Bahurim had cursed him at Mahanaim, but David had sworn by the LORD to spare him, so Solomon was to send him home.

wrong_details.wrong: Solomon was to send him home
wrong_details.true: Solomon was to bring Shimei's gray head down to Sheol in blood

lines.text: David was buried in the City of David after reigning forty years, and Solomon's kingdom was firmly established.
